modern_3d_status: Not run within the free CPU budget; modern comparison is the declared controlled common subset, not a modern3D ranking.

execution_resource_profile.runners: Standard free public-repository ubuntu22.04 x64 or ubuntu24.04 ARM runners; heterogeneous CPU models/architectures recorded. Timings compared only within paired jobs.

success_targets.uncertainty: Exploratory paired spatial-component bootstrap,2000 resamples,seed20261030; shared terrain/renderer/unknown trajectory dependence remains.
success_targets.interpretation: Point targets and grouped support are separate. A gain interval spanning zero is inconclusive; a speed/noninferiority claim needs its paired lower accuracy bound at least minus3points.

secondary_3d_metric.note: Declared simulated pose diagnostic, not a spacecraft requirement or verified navigation accuracy.

pixel_units.note: 128px inference benchmark; error_px is benchmark pixels, error_native_px maps to original512px renders. POLAR1216px crop has9.5 native pixels per benchmark pixel.

shared_brightness_proxy.note: Fraction of mutually valid pixels bright in both images; not a Sun-angle or causal difficulty label.

scope: South-pole physical renders; all final results consumed once. Sensor reference uncertainty remains separate.
negative_dependency: Negative pairs reuse both terrain endpoints; report component dependence, not independent-binomial certainty.
